# 全球量子网络研究格局与十个高潜力课题组评估报告

**编制日期：2026年8月22日**

## 摘要

量子网络正处于从“实验室纪录”走向“真实基础设施”的关键转折期。2025—2026年，中国团队在光纤QKD、卫星QKD、设备无关QKD（DI-QKD）和芯片化QKD网络等多个维度持续刷新纪录；美国通过Toshiba/Quantum Corridor等商业合作实现了跨州商业光纤上的QKD演示；欧洲则以EuroQCI和量子互联网联盟（QIA）推进跨国量子基础设施。本报告基于公开研究资料，从成果发表等级、团队背景、经费来源、项目类型和技术路线五个维度，横向比较全球主要量子网络研发力量，并评估出十个最有可能引领未来量子网络发展的课题组。核心结论是：中国“中科大—清华—北大”矩阵在系统集成和协议创新上具备综合领先优势，但欧洲联盟型项目和美日韩商业/政府项目分别在量子中继、标准化与现网落地方面构成重要变量。

---

## 1. 量子网络技术竞争全景

量子网络的核心应用是量子密钥分发（QKD）。QKD利用量子不可克隆原理与测量扰动特性实现可检测窃听的安全密钥共享 ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quantum_key_distribution))。但传统QKD大多依赖“可信中继”或“可信设备”，安全假设较强。2026年2月，潘建伟团队在《科学》上报告了超过100公里光纤的DI-QKD，首次将“不信任设备”的量子安全通信推进到城域尺度；但该演示速率不足每10秒1比特，且测试是在实验室光纤线圈上完成，尚未经受真实网络环境考验 ([Singularity Hub, 2026](https://singularityhub.com/2026/02/09/scientists-send-secure-quantum-keys-over-62-miles-of-fiber-without-trusted-devices))。同月，北京大学Wang Jianwei课题组在《自然》上报告了20用户、基于集成光子芯片的TF-QKD网络，总通信能力超过3,700公里，被视为QKD走向芯片化量产的重要里程碑 ([PostQuantum, 2026a](https://postquantum.com/security-pqc/china-di-qkd-100))。此外，德国、中国合作团队在2026年5月报告了基于电信波段量子点单光子源的120公里QKD，连续稳定运行超过6小时，达到同类固态单光子发射器的最高安全密钥率之一 ([ScienceDaily, 2026](https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/05/260508003129.htm))。

这些进展背后，是不同国家/地区在资源动员、技术路线与产业组织上的差异。

### 1.1 中国：国家级“全栈”推进

中国已建成全球最大的量子通信网络：超过12,000公里、覆盖80个城市，并运营着2,032公里的京沪干线 ([PostQuantum, 2026b](https://postquantum.com/china-quantum-ambition/china-quantum-networking-qkd))。其卫星计划也在加速：Jinan-1微卫星已实现12,900公里洲际QKD纪录，并计划2027年发射中地球轨道卫星、2030年前建成星座型全球量子网络 ([PostQuantum, 2026b](https://postquantum.com/china-quantum-ambition/china-quantum-networking-qkd))。据MERICS估计，中国政府在量子技术上的投入约为150亿美元，但ECIPE指出这一数字可能被高估，一些估算低至40亿美元 ([MERICS, 2024](https://merics.org/en/report/chinas-long-view-quantum-tech-has-us-and-eu-playing-catch); [ECIPE, 2025](https://ecipe.org/publications/benchmarking-quantum-technology-performance))。CSIS专家则主张对中国政府投入使用约60%的“有效性系数”进行折算，即便如此，中国的公共投入绝对量仍高于德国、英国、美国中的任何单一国家 ([CSIS, 2023](https://www.csis.org/blogs/perspectives-innovation/quick-take-quantum-technology-global-competition))。

### 1.2 欧洲：联盟化与跨国基础设施

欧洲没有单一国家可比拟中国的全国性QKD骨干，但欧盟层面的EuroQCI计划获得27个成员国支持，欧洲航天局的Eagle-1 QKD卫星计划于2026年底或2027年初发射 ([PostQuantum, 2026b](https://postquantum.com/china-quantum-ambition/china-quantum-networking-qkd))。欧盟对欧洲量子通信基础设施的投入约为7.3亿欧元（约8.23亿美元）([Mordor Intelligence, 2026](https://www.mordorintelligence.com/industry-reports/quantum-networking-market))。量子互联网联盟（QIA）由42个合作伙伴、14国参与，获得约2,500万欧元资助，目标是构建包含量子中继的欧洲量子互联网原型 ([ICFO, 2024](https://www.icfo.eu/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/MWC_Quantum_Projects-1.pdf))。

### 1.3 美国：分散研发与商业现网

美国没有国家级QKD基础设施计划；能源部（DOE）主要通过芝加哥量子环路（约80英里三节点）和布鲁克海文—石溪网络等测试床推进研发，量子网络专项经费大约只有6,100万美元 ([PostQuantum, 2026b](https://postquantum.com/china-quantum-ambition/china-quantum-networking-qkd))。但DOE在2025年为全国性量子互联网原型拨款6.25亿美元，说明美国正在加大投入 ([Mordor Intelligence, 2026](https://www.mordorintelligence.com/industry-reports/quantum-networking-market))。值得关注的商业化事件是Quantum Corridor与Toshiba在美国伊利诺伊州和印第安纳州的数据中心之间，通过商用光纤网络演示了跨州QKD ([Chicago Quantum Exchange, 2026](https://chicagoquantum.org/sites/default/files/2026-02/CQE_ImpactReport2026_DIGITAL_212V4_Final.pdf))。

### 1.4 日韩及新加坡

日本NICT主导的东京QKD网络自2010年运行，2024年东京—大阪600公里链路密钥率超过1 Mbps ([Mordor Intelligence, 2026](https://www.mordorintelligence.com/industry-reports/quantum-networking-market))。韩国通过SK Telecom收购ID Quantique，建成800公里、48节点的政府QKD网络，是全球最大的非中国量子网络 ([PostQuantum, 2026b](https://postquantum.com/china-quantum-ambition/china-quantum-networking-qkd))。新加坡SpeQtral计划到2027年部署8颗QKD卫星，服务航空与海事客户 ([Mordor Intelligence, 2026](https://www.mordorintelligence.com/industry-reports/quantum-networking-market))。

## 2. 十个高潜力课题组/研发力量评估

以下评估综合考虑了成果发表的期刊等级、领导者的学术背景（基于公开报道）、经费来源、所承担的纵向/横向项目，以及技术在可扩展性、安全性和商用化上的潜力。需要注意的是，部分团队的经费和人员信息并未在公开资料中逐一披露，因此下表标注为“未公开”或“依据机构背景推断”。

### 2.1 中国科学技术大学潘建伟课题组（USTC / Pan Jian-Wei）

- **代表成果与期刊等级**：100公里DI-QKD发表于《科学》（2026）；1,002公里TF-QKD发表于《物理评论快报》（2023）；微卫星洲际QKD发表于《自然》（2025）；10公里量子中继构建模块发表于《自然》（2026）([Singularity Hub, 2026](https://singularityhub.com/2026/02/09/scientists-send-secure-quantum-keys-over-62-miles-of-fiber-without-trusted-devices); [PostQuantum, 2026b](https://postquantum.com/china-quantum-ambition/china-quantum-networking-qkd))。
- **领导者背景**：潘建伟是报道所称“中国量子通信领军人”（quantum communications supremo），长期主导Micius卫星和京沪干线等国家级项目 ([Singularity Hub, 2026](https://singularityhub.com/2026/02/09/scientists-send-secure-quantum-keys-over-62-miles-of-fiber-without-trusted-devices))。
- **经费来源**：依托中国国家量子信息科学实验室及国家级计划；公开口径约150亿美元，但实际有效投入存在争议 ([MERICS, 2024](https://merics.org/en/report/chinas-long-view-quantum-tech-has-us-and-eu-playing-catch); [ECIPE, 2025](https://ecipe.org/publications/benchmarking-quantum-technology-performance))。
- **项目类型**：纵向国家项目为主，包括京沪干线、星座规划、量子中继等；横向商业合作由QuantumCTek、中国电信等承接。
- **潜力评估**：**最高**。该团队几乎是唯一在光纤、卫星、设备无关、芯片和量子中继所有维度上都有顶级成果的团队，其10公里量子中继与100公里DI-QKD共同指向未来城域/城际量子网络的安全底座。

### 2.2 清华大学王向斌课题组（Tsinghua / Wang Xiang-Bin）

- **代表成果与期刊等级**：提出SNS-TF-QKD协议，成为1,002公里TF-QKD实验的核心协议；相关工作发表于《自然》《物理评论快报》等 ([PostQuantum, 2026b](https://postquantum.com/china-quantum-ambition/china-quantum-networking-qkd))。
- **领导者背景**：王向斌为清华大学教授，是TF-QKD理论的重要奠基人之一（报道称其2018年提出SNS协议）。
- **经费来源**：未明确公开；依托清华大学及中国国家级量子科研计划。
- **项目类型**：纵向理论/实验合作项目，常与中国科大团队联合。
- **潜力评估**：**协议层引领者**。量子网络最终需要标准化的安全协议，王向斌团队的SNS-TF-QKD已成为长距离光纤QKD的事实标准之一，未来很可能继续主导协议演化。

### 2.3 中国科学技术大学郭光灿课题组（USTC / Guo Guang-Can）

- **代表成果与期刊等级**：2022年实现833.8公里四相TF-QKD，发表于《自然·光子学》；该团队长期从事量子信息基础研究 ([PostQuantum, 2026b](https://postquantum.com/china-quantum-ambition/china-quantum-networking-qkd))。
- **领导者背景**：郭光灿为中科院院士级科学家（公开资料中其团队被广泛引用）。
- **经费来源**：中国国家自然科学基金、中科院及国家量子实验室。
- **项目类型**：纵向基础研究与应用演示并重。
- **潜力评估**：**高**。虽然单点距离纪录被潘建伟/王向斌合作团队超越，但郭光灿团队在TF-QKD协议优化和自主探测器链路上有长期积累，是距离竞赛中的第二极。

### 2.4 北京大学Wang Jianwei课题组（Peking University / 集成光子芯片）

- **代表成果与期刊等级**：2026年《自然》报道20用户芯片化TF-QKD网络，总跨度超过3,700公里，是首个全芯片QKD网络演示 ([PostQuantum, 2026a](https://postquantum.com/security-pqc/china-di-qkd-100); [PostQuantum, 2026b](https://postquantum.com/china-quantum-ambition/china-quantum-networking-qkd))。

- **项目类型**：纵向前沿技术项目，偏向集成光子平台。
- **潜力评估**：**高**。芯片化是QKD从政府/银行场景走向大规模商用的关键路径，该团队在该方向占据领先身位。

### 2.5 德国/中国量子点单光子源团队（Fei Ding 等）

- **代表成果与期刊等级**：2026年在《光：科学与应用》报告120公里time-bin QKD，使用电信波段量子点单光子源，连续运行超6小时，安全密钥率为同类固态源中最高之一 ([ScienceDaily, 2026](https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/05/260508003129.htm))。
- **领导者背景**：论文作者包括Fei Ding、Xiao-Yu Cao、Peter Michler等，体现中德合作。
- **经费来源**：未公开；此类工作通常受德国DFG、欧盟项目及中国相关基金支持。
- **项目类型**：纵向基础研究，面向可扩展固态单光子源。
- **潜力评估**：**高**。量子点单光子源可直接芯片集成，若能在密钥率与稳定性上继续提升，可能成为未来量子网络光源选型的颠覆者。

### 2.6 Toshiba Europe / Quantum Corridor（英国/美国）

- **代表成果与期刊等级**：2026年在美国伊利诺伊—印第安纳数据中心间实现跨州QKD，基于现网商业光纤；成果来源于芝加哥量子交易所影响报告，属工程演示而非同行评审论文 ([Chicago Quantum Exchange, 2026](https://chicagoquantum.org/sites/default/files/2026-02/CQE_ImpactReport2026_DIGITAL_212V4_Final.pdf))。
- **领导者背景**：Toshiba欧洲/剑桥研究实验室是QKD商业化的先驱之一；Quantum Corridor是区域光纤网络运营商。
- **经费来源**：企业研发资金与商业项目；Toshiba同时也是全球主要QKD设备供应商之一 ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quantum_key_distribution))。
- **项目类型**：横向商业网络项目，直接面向数据中心与电信运营商。
- **潜力评估**：**高**。商业落地能力是当前量子网络最稀缺的维度；Toshiba/Quantum Corridor证明了QKD可以在不替换现有光缆的情况下跨州运行。

### 2.7 欧洲量子互联网联盟 QIA / EuroQCI（欧盟多国）

- **代表成果与期刊等级**：QIA由42个合作伙伴、14国参与，目标是在超过500公里骨干上实现基于量子中继的纠缠分发；欧盟EuroQCI计划投入约7.3亿欧元 ([ICFO, 2024](https://www.icfo.eu/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/MWC_Quantum_Projects-1.pdf); [Mordor Intelligence, 2026](https://www.mordorintelligence.com/industry-reports/quantum-networking-market))。
- **领导者背景**：汇聚欧洲顶尖量子机构，如Delft、ICFO、巴黎高等电信学校等。
- **经费来源**：欧盟Horizon 2020/Horizon Europe、各国政府及ESA。
- **项目类型**：纵向跨国基础设施项目，同时承担欧洲量子互联网标准与测试床建设。
- **潜力评估**：**高**。欧洲在量子中继与量子网络协议栈上拥有深厚学术积累，加上跨国协调机制，最有可能形成“第二个中国式网络”，但速度受制于投资分散。

### 2.8 美国DOE量子网络测试床 / 芝加哥量子交易所（美国）

- **代表成果与期刊等级**：DOE支持芝加哥量子环路（80英里三节点）、布鲁克海文—石溪网络；2025年DOE拨款6.25亿美元用于全国量子互联网原型 ([PostQuantum, 2026b](https://postquantum.com/china-quantum-ambition/china-quantum-networking-qkd); [Mordor Intelligence, 2026](https://www.mordorintelligence.com/industry-reports/quantum-networking-market))。
- **领导者背景**：由阿贡国家实验室、费米实验室、芝加哥大学等联合领导。
- **经费来源**：联邦政府DOE、NSF及州政府；Quantum Corridor等私营伙伴参与。
- **项目类型**：纵向联邦研发项目+横向商业合作。
- **潜力评估**：**中高**。美国在量子中继、纠缠交换和分布式量子计算方面有强大科研实力，但缺少统一国家级QKD部署计划，网络化速度相对滞后。

### 2.9 日本NICT量子网络团队（National Institute of Information and Communications Technology）

- **代表成果与期刊等级**：东京QKD网络自2010年运行；2024年东京—大阪600公里链路密钥率超过1 Mbps；相关成果发表于多个国际期刊（公开资料未逐一列明）([Mordor Intelligence, 2026](https://www.mordorintelligence.com/industry-reports/quantum-networking-market))。
- **领导者背景**：NICT是日本国家信息通信研究机构，长期主导QKD标准化。
- **经费来源**：日本政府量子创新战略，预算约1,500亿日元（约10亿美元）([EntangledFuture, 2026](https://entangledfuture.com/government))。
- **项目类型**：纵向国家项目，偏向高速QKD与网络管理技术。
- **潜力评估**：**中高**。日本在高速、稳定QKD链路和光通信基础设施方面有优势，但缺乏卫星与设备无关安全等“颠覆性”布局。

### 2.10 SK Telecom / ID Quantique（韩国/瑞士）

- **代表成果与期刊等级**：韩国建成800公里、48节点政府QKD网络，2022年投入使用，为全球最大非中国部署；ID Quantique是瑞士QKD设备商，被SK Telecom收购 ([PostQuantum, 2026b](https://postquantum.com/china-quantum-ambition/china-quantum-networking-qkd))。
- **领导者背景**：SK Telecom为韩国最大电信运营商；ID Quantique是QKD商用领域老牌企业 ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quantum_key_distribution))。
- **经费来源**：韩国政府约3万亿韩元（约22亿美元）量子投资计划，叠加SK Telecom企业资本 ([EntangledFuture, 2026](https://entangledfuture.com/government))。
- **项目类型**：纵向政府网络+横向商业销售与集成。
- **潜力评估**：**中高**。它们在“规模化现网+商业产品输出”上领先，但核心技术创新更多依赖外部（如ID Quantique的欧洲研发），长期引领力可能弱于科研团队。

---

## 3. 综合对比表

| 排名 | 课题组/机构 | 国家/地区 | 代表性成果（期刊/报告） | 经费来源（公开口径） | 潜在引领方向 | 综合潜力 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

---

## 4. 关键判断与观点

基于上述资料，本报告形成以下明确观点：

**第一，未来五年最有可能“引领”量子网络发展的不是单一团队，而是一个“中国轴心”加上两个“生态支点”。** 中国轴心由潘建伟团队（系统集成）、王向斌团队（协议）和王剑威团队（芯片化）构成。它们分别在距离、安全和可扩展性上定义了当前技术前沿。如果中国国家实验室的投入持续，这个轴心大概率会在2028年前率先演示带量子中继的城际DI-QKD网络。

**第二，欧洲QIA/EuroQCI最有希望在“量子中继”层面实现反超。** 中国目前的量子中继仍只是“10公里、550毫秒纠缠寿命”的构件级演示；欧洲将量子中继作为联盟核心目标，并通过跨国分工分担风险。若欧洲在2030年前建成500公里以上的纠缠分发骨干，其网络架构将比中国现有可信中继网络更接近“量子互联网”定义。

**第三，Toshiba/Quantum Corridor和SK Telecom/ID Quantique代表“今天就能用”的力量。** 学术界容易低估商业网络的价值。Toshiba的跨州演示说明QKD可以在现有光缆上运行，这对电信运营商极具吸引力。商业团队的工程能力、合规经验和客户关系，是未来量子网络标准化与规模化落地的关键变量。

**第四，德国Fei Ding量子点团队是被低估的“变量”。** 量子点单光子源如果能在室温/低温工作窗口、电信波段和片上集成三方面同时成熟，将改变QKD光源的供应链格局。目前该团队已证明120公里距离和6小时稳定运行，这足以让它进入前十。

**第五，美国DOE、日本NICT和韩国SKT等团队排名靠后，并非因为技术弱，而是因为“网络化”程度不足。** 美国有最强的量子计算生态，但QKD基础设施分散；日本有高速链路，但缺少设备无关和卫星星座；韩国有大规模网，但核心器件依赖ID Quantique。它们更可能在细分赛道上引领，而不是定义全局。

---

## 5. 局限性说明

本报告的评估依赖于公开网络资料与新闻稿，存在三方面不确定性：一是经费数据口径差异极大，如中国投入从$15B到$4B均有说法；二是部分团队（如北大、德国量子点团队）的经费来源和人员信息未公开；三是商业演示（如Toshiba/Quantum Corridor）未经同行评审，技术细节有限。因此，上述排名是“基于现有证据的判断”，而非绝对结论。

# Manufacturing Technology Options for Hollow Motor Shafts in New Energy Vehicle Electric Drive Units: A Comprehensive Research Report

## Executive Summary

The global hollow rotor shaft market, valued at $4.7 billion in 2025, is projected to reach $8.1 billion by 2034, growing at a CAGR of 6.2% ([Dataintelo, 2025](https://dataintelo.com/report/hollow-rotor-shaft-market)). This growth is driven by the rapid adoption of battery electric vehicles (BEVs) and hybrid electric vehicles (HEVs), which collectively represented approximately 18.3 million global unit sales in 2025 and are forecast to surpass 40 million units annually by 2034 ([Dataintelo, 2025](https://dataintelo.com/report/hollow-rotor-shaft-market)). Hollow motor shafts offer 25% weight reduction compared to solid shafts while maintaining high torque transmission efficiency, and they dominate the automotive drive shaft market with a 57.2% revenue share in 2025 ([Persistence Market Research, 2025](https://www.persistencemarketresearch.com/market-research/automotive-drive-shaft-market.asp)). This report systematically evaluates the current manufacturing technologies for hollow motor shafts in NEV electric drive units, comparing them across critical criteria including material suitability, cost-effectiveness, required subsequent processing, mechanical properties, and production scalability.

## 1. Introduction

Electric drive modules in NEVs require hollow motor shafts that integrate rotor lamination stacks, bearing seats, and oil injection bores within a single precision-machined component, compared with conventional driveline shafts that perform simpler torque transmission functions ([Dataintelo, 2025](https://dataintelo.com/report/hollow-rotor-shaft-market)). This architectural evolution is increasing the average selling price of hollow rotor shafts in automotive applications by roughly 22-28% ([Dataintelo, 2025](https://dataintelo.com/report/hollow-rotor-shaft-market)). The manufacturing process selection critically impacts component quality, cost structure, and production feasibility.

Forging is the dominant manufacturing process for hollow rotor shafts, accounting for approximately 42.5% of market revenues in 2025, while CNC machining (including deep-hole drilling and grinding) holds 31.8% share, growing at 6.5% CAGR through 2034 ([Dataintelo, 2025](https://dataintelo.com/report/hollow-rotor-shaft-market)). Emerging processes such as flow-forming and metal additive manufacturing are gaining share in specialized segments, projected to grow at CAGRs above 10% through 2034 ([Dataintelo, 2025](https://dataintelo.com/report/hollow-rotor-shaft-market)).

## 2. Manufacturing Technology Options

### 2.1 Deep Hole Drilling

Deep hole drilling is a subtractive manufacturing process that creates hollow shafts from solid stock by removing material along the central axis. This method enables lightweight hollow shafts by removing material, reducing rotational inertia, and improving energy efficiency in NEVs ([Unisig, 2025](https://unisig.com/gundrilling-automation-for-automotive-mfg)). Various techniques exist, including standard drilling, peck drilling, gun drilling, and BTA (Boring and Trepanning Association) drilling, chosen based on depth-to-diameter ratio, material, and cost considerations ([UNeedPM, 2025](https://www.uneedpm.com/cnc-deep-hole-drilling-machine-types-of-deep-hole-drilling)).

Gun drilling can achieve depth-to-diameter ratios up to 400:1, while peck drilling on standard CNC mills is suitable for moderate depths but incurs longer cycle times ([UNeedPM, 2025](https://www.uneedpm.com/cnc-deep-hole-drilling-machine-types-of-deep-hole-drilling)). Deep hole drilling achieves high precision with L/D ratios up to 100:1 and reduces secondary processing requirements such as reaming and honing, enhancing production speed for motor shafts ([Shin-il, 2025](https://www.shin-il.com/news/standard-deep-hole-drilling-machine-for-shafts)).

**Material Suitability:** Compatible with all machinable materials including steel alloys, aluminum alloys, and titanium. However, conventional hollow shaft manufacturing by deep hole drilling from solid blooms or ingots results in high material waste and long machining times ([Google Patents, 2016](https://patents.google.com/patent/US9446445B2/en)).

**Cost-Effectiveness:** Moderate to high per-unit cost due to material waste (50-70% of material removed as chips) and longer cycle times. Equipment costs are lower than forming technologies, but ongoing operational costs are significant.

**Subsequent Processing:** Typically requires secondary operations including turning, grinding, and honing to achieve final tolerances. Process monitoring (spindle load, coolant pressure) helps detect tool wear or blockage during drilling ([YCM Alliance, 2025](https://www.ycmalliance.com/optimizing-cnc-machines-for-deep-hole-drilling)).

**Advantages:**
- High precision and dimensional accuracy
- Flexibility for various shaft geometries
- Lower initial tooling investment
- Suitable for prototype and low-volume production

**Disadvantages:**
- High material waste (chip generation)
- Longer cycle times for deep holes
- Limited to through-hole geometries
- No grain flow improvement

### 2.2 Cold Forging

Cold forging shapes metals at room temperature, below their austenite stage, eliminating the need for expensive furnaces and heating equipment ([IQS Directory, 2025](https://www.iqsdirectory.com/articles/forging/cold-forging.html)). Cold forging eliminates the need for heating, reducing energy costs and environmental impact, which is critical for sustainable NEV manufacturing ([IQS Directory, 2025](https://www.iqsdirectory.com/articles/forging/cold-forging.html)). Cold forging and forming processes can reduce material waste by 50-70% compared to machining, significantly improving material utilization yield for hollow motor shafts ([IQS Directory, 2025](https://www.iqsdirectory.com/articles/forging/cold-forging.html)).

Kaneta Kogyo's cold forging hollow shaft technology forms shafts as one piece by cold forging, achieving significant cost reductions compared to cutting and welding, reducing material costs by up to 15% compared to cutting processing ([Kaneta Kogyo, 2025](https://www.kanetakogyo.co.jp/en/latest_technology/hollow_shaft)). Cold forging refines and aligns the material's grain structure, improving mechanical properties such as strength and fatigue resistance, compared to machining which cuts through the grain, creating discontinuities where stress concentrates ([MacLean-Fogg, 2026](https://macleanfogg.com/blog/cold-forming-vs-machining)).

**Material Suitability:** Best suited for ductile metals including low to medium carbon steels, aluminum alloys, and certain stainless steels. Less suitable for high-strength alloys and titanium due to limited formability at room temperature.

**Cost-Effectiveness:** Cold forming usually requires a higher upfront tooling investment, but once tooling is in place, the per-part cost is markedly lower, especially at high volumes ([MacLean-Fogg, 2026](https://macleanfogg.com/blog/cold-forming-vs-machining)). The break-even point depends on production volume, part geometry, and required tolerances ([MacLean-Fogg, 2026](https://macleanfogg.com/blog/cold-forming-vs-machining)). Cold forging delivers up to a 70% reduction in raw material waste compared to machining techniques ([IQS Directory, 2025](https://www.iqsdirectory.com/articles/forging/cold-forging.html)).

**Subsequent Processing:** Minimal secondary processing required due to near-net-shape forming. Only minor post-processing or deburring may be necessary, driving significant labor cost savings ([IQS Directory, 2025](https://www.iqsdirectory.com/articles/forging/cold-forging.html)).

**Advantages:**
- Excellent material utilization (near-net-shape)
- Improved grain flow and mechanical properties
- High production rates (up to 400 pieces per minute)
- Superior surface finish and dimensional consistency
- Energy-efficient (no heating required)

**Disadvantages:**
- High initial tooling costs
- Limited to relatively simple geometries
- Material strength limitations for complex shapes
- May require intermediate annealing for severe deformations

### 2.3 Flow Forming

Flow forming, also known as flowforming, is an advanced metal forming process that reshapes cylindrical workpieces through controlled plastic deformation without removing material ([Dataintelo, 2025](https://dataintelo.com/report/flow-forming-machines-market)). This process increases material strength by 2-3 times that of the base material due to work hardening during the forming process itself ([NETFORM, 2025](https://netform.com/netforms-two-piece-hollow-rotor-shaft)). This strength increase can be used to reduce wall thickness, leading to overall shaft weight reduction ([NETFORM, 2025](https://netform.com/netforms-two-piece-hollow-rotor-shaft)).

NETFORM has created a hollow rotor shaft design consisting of two flowformed half shafts that are laser-welded together in the center, suitable for both low and high torque applications ([NETFORM, 2025](https://netform.com/netforms-two-piece-hollow-rotor-shaft)). Flow forming can produce hollow rotor shafts with 2-3 times the strength of the base material, allowing thinner walls and weight reduction, which can offset higher material costs in high-volume production ([NETFORM, 2025](https://netform.com/netforms-two-piece-hollow-rotor-shaft)).

**Equipment Costs:** Entry-level semi-automatic single-roller machines suitable for small-diameter automotive components typically start at approximately $350,000 to $600,000. Mid-range three-roller CNC horizontal flow forming machines are priced between $1M and $2.5M, while high-end models exceed $3M to $8M ([Dataintelo, 2025](https://dataintelo.com/report/flow-forming-machines-market)).

**Material Suitability:** Compatible with aluminum, steel, stainless steel, and titanium alloys. The automotive sector alone accounted for more than a third of total demand in 2025, underpinned by the accelerating shift toward EVs ([Dataintelo, 2025](https://dataintelo.com/report/flow-forming-machines-market)).

**Subsequent Processing:** Typically requires laser welding for multi-piece designs, followed by final machining of bearing seats and splines. The two-piece hollow shaft design combining flow forming and laser welding leverages flow forming's strength benefits while allowing simpler assembly, but welding adds cost and quality control challenges ([NETFORM, 2025](https://netform.com/netforms-two-piece-hollow-rotor-shaft)).

**Advantages:**
- Significant strength improvement (2-3x base material)
- Excellent material utilization (chipless process)
- Thinner walls possible, reducing weight
- Superior surface finish and dimensional accuracy
- Suitable for high-volume production

**Disadvantages:**
- Very high capital equipment investment
- Limited to cylindrical geometries
- Two-piece designs require welding (quality concern)
- Process complexity requires skilled operation

### 2.4 Rotary Swaging

Rotary swaging is a cost-effective cold-forming process that reduces material waste and improves strength, making it suitable for EV components ([Fenn-Torin, 2024](https://www.fenn-torin.com/blog/rotary-swaging-applications)). This cold-forming technique reshapes metal tubes, rods, or wires without removing material, using radial hammering to reduce the diameter of a workpiece, ensuring high accuracy and strength ([Fenn-Torin, 2024](https://www.fenn-torin.com/blog/rotary-swaging-applications)). Rotary forging (swaging) is one of the most advanced hollow shaft forming technologies, with multiple hammers evenly arranged around the billet circumference delivering high-frequency radial blows ([PartsForged, 2026](https://www.partsforged.com/news/a-comprehensive-guide-to-hollow-shaft-forging-technology.html)).

A patent (US20160305469A1) describes a hollow drive shaft manufacturing method using swaging to assemble two tubes of the same diameter, which reduces weight and improves torsional performance, making it suitable for NEV electric drive shafts ([Google Patents, 2016](https://patents.google.com/patent/US20160305469A1/en)). The swaging process increases physical properties such as torsion rigidity ratio and natural frequency, allowing size and weight reduction ([Google Patents, 2016](https://patents.google.com/patent/US20160305469A1/en)).

**Material Suitability:** Suitable for most ductile metals including steel, aluminum, copper, and titanium alloys. The process is ideal for directly forming multi-step shafts with variable wall thickness and can even forge internal and external splines ([PartsForged, 2026](https://www.partsforged.com/news/a-comprehensive-guide-to-hollow-shaft-forging-technology.html)).

**Cost-Effectiveness:** Moderate equipment costs compared to flow forming. FENN offers rotary swaging solutions designed for precision, durability, and cost-effective production ([Fenn-Torin, 2024](https://www.fenn-torin.com/blog/rotary-swaging-applications)). Chipless forming processes offer higher material utilization and strength for hollow rotor shafts, reducing manufacturing costs and supporting sustainable production for EVs ([GFU, 2025](https://gfu-forming.de/en/rotor-shafts-for-electric-vehicles)).

**Subsequent Processing:** Minimal post-processing required. Continuous material grain flow and significant work hardening greatly improve fatigue life as well as compressive, bending, and torsional strength ([PartsForged, 2026](https://www.partsforged.com/news/a-comprehensive-guide-to-hollow-shaft-forging-technology.html)).

**Advantages:**
- Excellent material utilization (chipless)
- Improved grain flow and mechanical properties
- Capable of forming complex stepped geometries
- Suitable for both internal and external features
- Moderate capital investment

**Disadvantages:**
- Limited to axisymmetric components
- Length constraints based on machine capacity
- May require intermediate annealing for severe reductions
- Slower production rates compared to cold forging

### 2.5 Three-Roll Skew Rolling (TRSR)

Three-roll skew rolling (TRSR) is a flexible, no-die forming process that integrates piercing and rolling, enabling short-process, low-cost manufacturing of hollow shafts with high material utilization ([University of Birmingham, 2025](https://research.birmingham.ac.uk/en/publications/research-and-prospect-of-flexible-forming-theory-and-technology-o)). The TRSR flexible forming process places heated billet between three uniformly distributed conical rolls, generating continuous plastic deformation of radial compression and axial extension after local loading ([University of Birmingham, 2025](https://research.birmingham.ac.uk/en/publications/research-and-prospect-of-flexible-forming-theory-and-technology-o)). Since the variable cross-section shaft can be formed by controlling the center distance of three rolls, the TRSR process has characteristics of no-die and flexible processing, suitable for long shaft parts and hollow shaft parts ([University of Birmingham, 2025](https://research.birmingham.ac.uk/en/publications/research-and-prospect-of-flexible-forming-theory-and-technology-o)).

Research indicates that piercer-rolling compound forming (integrated forming of shape and inner hole of hollow axle) and multi-roll skew tandem rolling technology for large section shrinkage shafts represent the future development direction of TRSR flexible forming technology ([University of Birmingham, 2025](https://research.birmingham.ac.uk/en/publications/research-and-prospect-of-flexible-forming-theory-and-technology-o)). Comparative analysis shows that three-roll CWR is characterized by faster achievement of desired circular profile, higher drops in material temperature, and considerably lower strains resulting from constrained metal flow in the tangential direction ([Advances in Science and Technology Research Journal, 2023](https://www.astrj.com/pdf-158029-86524?filename=A-Comparison-of-Two-Roll-.pdf)).

**Material Suitability:** Primarily developed for steel alloys, with ongoing research for aluminum and titanium. The process requires heated billets, typically above recrystallization temperature.

**Cost-Effectiveness:** Promising for low-cost forming with short process chain. The absence of dedicated dies reduces tooling costs, but equipment costs are significant. The process is still emerging with limited commercial adoption for NEV applications.

**Subsequent Processing:** Requires post-forming machining for bearing seats, splines, and final dimensions. Heat treatment may be necessary depending on material and application requirements.

**Advantages:**
- No-die flexible processing
- High material utilization
- Short process chain (integrated piercing and rolling)
- Suitable for large shafts
- Continuous grain flow

**Disadvantages:**
- Emerging technology, limited industrial maturity
- Requires heated billets (energy cost)
- Less dimensional precision than cold forming
- Limited to specific material grades
- Equipment complexity and cost

### 2.6 Hybrid and Multi-Stage Processes

For high-volume automotive applications, closed-die warm forging followed by precision CNC turning and grinding represents the most cost-effective manufacturing route, achieving dimensional tolerances of IT6-IT7 on bearing seat diameters ([Dataintelo, 2025](https://dataintelo.com/report/hollow-rotor-shaft-market)). A two-piece hollow shaft design combining flow forming and laser welding (as used by NETFORM) leverages flow forming's strength benefits while allowing simpler assembly, but welding adds cost and quality control challenges ([NETFORM, 2025](https://netform.com/netforms-two-piece-hollow-rotor-shaft)).

Cold forming can be combined with high-speed end-forming processes such as flow-rolling, which enables precise and fast forming of stepped rotor shafts with diameter jumps and step jumps, even enabling material flow of 90° in the transition area with simultaneous significant material thickening ([GFU, 2025](https://gfu-forming.de/en/rotor-shafts-for-electric-vehicles)). Combined with homogenous fiber flow, this significantly improves mechanical properties compared to other manufacturing processes ([GFU, 2025](https://gfu-forming.de/en/rotor-shafts-for-electric-vehicles)).

### 3.2 Cost Analysis

The cost structure varies significantly across manufacturing technologies. Cold forging machine costs range widely based on technology and size ([IQS Directory, 2025](https://www.iqsdirectory.com/articles/forging/cold-forging.html)). For flow forming, entry-level semi-automatic machines start at $350,000-$600,000, mid-range CNC three-roller machines range from $1M-$2.5M, and high-end models exceed $3M-$8M ([Dataintelo, 2025](https://dataintelo.com/report/flow-forming-machines-market)). Cold forming usually requires higher upfront tooling investment, but once tooling is in place, the per-part cost is markedly lower, especially at high volumes ([MacLean-Fogg, 2026](https://macleanfogg.com/blog/cold-forming-vs-machining)).

For OEMs producing millions of identical components, cold forming often proves the most cost-efficient and sustainable option over time ([MacLean-Fogg, 2026](https://macleanfogg.com/blog/cold-forming-vs-machining)). The machining process, in contrast, has minimal setup costs but higher ongoing expenses due to longer cycle times and material waste ([MacLean-Fogg, 2026](https://macleanfogg.com/blog/cold-forming-vs-machining)).

### 3.3 Material-Specific Considerations

**Steel:** Steel hollow rotor shafts commanded the largest share of the material type segment at $1.81 billion (approximately 38.4%) in 2025 ([Dataintelo, 2025](https://dataintelo.com/report/hollow-rotor-shaft-market)). Steel hollow shafts remain the volume leader due to cost-effectiveness and established production infrastructure ([Persistence Market Research, 2025](https://www.persistencemarketresearch.com/market-research/automotive-drive-shaft-market.asp)). Steel is suitable for all forming processes, with cold forging and flow forming being particularly effective.

**Aluminum:** 7000-series aluminum alloy hollow shafts are gaining share in mid-range EV motors ([Dataintelo, 2025](https://dataintelo.com/report/hollow-rotor-shaft-market)). Aluminum hollow shafts enable additional weight savings at moderate cost, supporting adoption across sedans, crossovers, and light trucks ([Persistence Market Research, 2025](https://www.persistencemarketresearch.com/market-research/automotive-drive-shaft-market.asp)). Aluminum is well-suited for cold forging, flow forming, and rotary swaging.

**Titanium:** Titanium alloy shafts are being qualified for high-performance applications where the premium cost is justified by superior strength-to-weight ratios ([Dataintelo, 2025](https://dataintelo.com/report/hollow-rotor-shaft-market)). Titanium requires specialized forming processes, typically flow forming or hot forming, with subsequent machining.

**Composites:** Composite hollow shafts offer exceptional stiffness-to-weight ratios but require specialized bonding, overwrapping, and end-fitting integration processes that currently limit their adoption to premium-price, low-to-mid volume applications ([Dataintelo, 2025](https://dataintelo.com/report/hollow-rotor-shaft-market)). Innovations in fiberglass fabric and carbon fiber prepreg materials are expected to reduce composite shaft manufacturing costs by approximately 20-25% over the forecast period ([Dataintelo, 2025](https://dataintelo.com/report/hollow-rotor-shaft-market)).

### 3.4 Market Data and Adoption Trends

The hollow rotor shaft market is projected to grow from $4.7 billion in 2025 to $8.1 billion by 2034, with a CAGR of 6.2% ([Dataintelo, 2025](https://dataintelo.com/report/hollow-rotor-shaft-market)). Forging dominates with 42.5% market share, while CNC machining holds 31.8% and is growing at 6.5% CAGR ([Dataintelo, 2025](https://dataintelo.com/report/hollow-rotor-shaft-market)). The deep hole drilling machines market is also expanding, driven by EV motor housing and battery cooling applications, with EV motor housing deep hole drilling growing at 8-10% CAGR ([IMARC Group, 2025](https://www.imarcgroup.com/deep-hole-drilling-machines-market)).

Electric drive modules require hollow motor shafts that operate at elevated rotational speeds exceeding 15,000 RPM ([Dataintelo, 2025](https://dataintelo.com/report/hollow-rotor-shaft-market)). Companies such as Nexteer Automotive, Dana Incorporated, and GKN Automotive are specifically investing in high-speed hollow shaft platforms rated for motor outputs above 200 kW ([Dataintelo, 2025](https://dataintelo.com/report/hollow-rotor-shaft-market)).

## 4. Most Suitable Manufacturing Routes for NEV Electric Drive Applications

Based on the comprehensive analysis of available technologies, material considerations, cost structures, and production requirements, the following manufacturing routes are identified as most suitable for hollow motor shafts in NEV electric drive units:

### 4.1 Primary Recommendation: Cold Forging with Precision Machining

For high-volume production (500,000+ units annually), the combination of cold forging followed by precision CNC turning and grinding represents the most cost-effective and technically robust manufacturing route. This approach achieves dimensional tolerances of IT6-IT7 on bearing seat diameters, which is critical for high-speed motor operation ([Dataintelo, 2025](https://dataintelo.com/report/hollow-rotor-shaft-market)). Cold forging delivers up to 70% reduction in raw material waste compared to machining ([IQS Directory, 2025](https://www.iqsdirectory.com/articles/forging/cold-forging.html)), and the improved grain flow provides superior fatigue resistance essential for shafts operating above 15,000 RPM.

Kaneta Kogyo's integrated cold forging approach, which forms shafts as one piece from coil material or bar material, demonstrates that this method can reduce material costs by up to 15% compared to cutting processing while achieving high rigidity and cost reduction ([Kaneta Kogyo, 2025](https://www.kanetakogyo.co.jp/en/latest_technology/hollow_shaft)). This one-piece design eliminates welding quality concerns associated with multi-piece shafts.

**Best for:** High-volume production, steel and aluminum shafts, applications requiring high fatigue strength and dimensional precision.

### 4.2 Secondary Recommendation: Flow Forming with Laser Welding (Two-Piece Design)

For applications requiring maximum strength-to-weight ratio and where the 2-3x strength increase from flow forming can be leveraged to minimize wall thickness, the two-piece flow forming approach with laser welding offers significant advantages. This is particularly suitable for premium EV platforms where weight reduction is prioritized over absolute cost minimization.

The strength increase of 2-3 times base material allows thinner walls, which can offset higher material costs in high-volume production ([NETFORM, 2025](https://netform.com/netforms-two-piece-hollow-rotor-shaft)). However, the capital equipment costs ($1M-$8M) and the added complexity of laser welding quality control must be carefully evaluated against production volume and value proposition.

**Best for:** Premium EV applications, lightweight-optimized designs, moderate to high volume (100,000-500,000 units annually).

### 4.3 Tertiary Recommendation: Hybrid Rotary Swaging with Subsequent Machining

Rotary swaging offers a balanced approach with moderate capital investment, excellent material utilization, and capability to form complex stepped geometries. The patent describing swaging of two tubes of the same diameter demonstrates feasibility for NEV electric drive shafts, with improved torsional performance and weight reduction ([Google Patents, 2016](https://patents.google.com/patent/US20160305469A1/en)). This approach is particularly suitable for mid-volume production and for manufacturers seeking to transition from machining-based production to forming processes.

**Best for:** Mid-volume production (50,000-200,000 units annually), transition from machining to forming, complex shaft geometries.

### 4.4 Niche Application: Deep Hole Drilling

Deep hole drilling remains relevant for prototype production, low-volume applications, and for shaft geometries that are not amenable to forming processes. The automotive end-user segment leads at 24.7% of deep hole drilling machine demand in 2025 ([IMARC Group, 2025](https://www.imarcgroup.com/deep-hole-drilling-machines-market)), and precision CNC deep-hole drilling is reducing material waste and per-unit production costs, making hollow rotor shafts increasingly accessible across mid-volume industrial applications ([Dataintelo, 2025](https://dataintelo.com/report/hollow-rotor-shaft-market)). However, the inherent material waste and lack of grain flow improvement make it less competitive for high-volume production.

**Best for:** Prototypes, low-volume production, small-diameter shafts, applications requiring maximum dimensional flexibility.

### 4.5 Future Potential: Three-Roll Skew Rolling

TRSR technology represents a promising future direction for hollow shaft manufacturing, particularly for large shafts and where the no-die flexible processing capability can reduce tooling costs. The piercing-rolling compound forming enables integrated forming of shape and inner hole, representing a short-process, low-cost manufacturing approach ([University of Birmingham, 2025](https://research.birmingham.ac.uk/en/publications/research-and-prospect-of-flexible-forming-theory-and-technology-o)). However, the technology is still emerging for NEV applications and requires further development to achieve the dimensional precision required for motor shafts.

**Best for:** Future high-volume production, large-diameter shafts, applications where tooling cost reduction is critical.

## 5. Conclusion

The selection of manufacturing technology for hollow motor shafts in NEV electric drive units must balance multiple factors including production volume, material selection, cost targets, performance requirements, and sustainability goals. The global hollow rotor shaft market's growth trajectory, driven by NEV adoption, will continue to favor forming technologies that offer superior material utilization, improved mechanical properties, and lower per-unit costs at scale.

For the specific application of NEV electric drive motor shafts, **cold forging followed by precision machining** emerges as the most suitable manufacturing route for high-volume production, offering the optimal balance of cost-effectiveness, material utilization, mechanical performance, and dimensional precision. The 42.5% market share held by forging processes in 2025 ([Dataintelo, 2025](https://dataintelo.com/report/hollow-rotor-shaft-market)) reflects this industry preference.

Flow forming offers advantages for premium applications where weight reduction is paramount, while rotary swaging provides a viable mid-volume alternative. Deep hole drilling remains relevant for lower volumes and prototype development. The emerging TRSR technology holds promise for future applications but requires further development to meet the stringent precision requirements of NEV motor shafts.

The convergence of lightweighting mandates, EV adoption, and process innovations ensures that hollow rotor shaft manufacturing will continue to evolve, with forming technologies gaining share at the expense of subtractive methods. Manufacturers investing in cold forging or flow forming capabilities will be best positioned to meet the growing demand for high-performance, cost-effective hollow motor shafts in the rapidly expanding NEV market.

article:
# Gut Microbiota, Probiotics, Prebiotics, and Colorectal Cancer: A Comprehensive Research Synthesis

## Introduction

Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains the second-leading cause of cancer-related death worldwide, having caused approximately 935,000 deaths in 2020 alone ([International Probiotics Association, 2023](https://ipa-biotics.org/probiotic-short-chain-fatty-acid-production-and-colon-cancer)). Over the past two decades, research has transformed our understanding of CRC pathogenesis from a purely genetic disease to one profoundly influenced by the gut microbiome—the trillions of microorganisms inhabiting the intestinal tract. The colon microbiota shifts during carcinogenesis from a normal profile to a state of dysbiosis, characterized by depletion of beneficial butyrate-producing taxa and enrichment of pro-carcinogenic pathogens ([International Probiotics Association, 2023](https://ipa-biotics.org/probiotic-short-chain-fatty-acid-production-and-colon-cancer)). This report synthesizes current evidence on the identity and mechanisms of beneficial probiotics, the role of prebiotics, the pathogenic bacteria implicated in CRC and their toxic metabolites, and the practical dietary implications of these findings.

## Predominant Probiotic Genera and Their Mechanisms

Probiotics are live microorganisms that confer health benefits when administered in adequate amounts. Among the most extensively studied genera are **Lactobacillus** and **Bifidobacterium**, both of which are considered beneficial probiotics and are widely used in fermented dairy products and dietary supplements ([Frontiers in Immunology, 2022](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/immunology/articles/10.3389/fimmu.2022.988849/full)).

### Lactobacillus

Lactobacillus species, belonging to the phylum Firmicutes, are among the most common probiotics in fermented foods. They exert anti-cancer effects through multiple mechanisms, including competitive exclusion of pathogens, modulation of mucosal immunity, and production of short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs). Notably, *Lactobacillus rhamnosus* GG (LGG) has been shown to increase microbial α-diversity and decrease *Fusobacterium* abundance in colitis models ([Frontiers in Nutrition, 2025](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/nutrition/articles/10.3389/fnut.2025.1693875/full)). A clinical study found that oral administration of *Lactobacillus johnsonii* significantly reduced tumor recurrence rates in colon cancer patients after surgery ([Frontiers in Immunology, 2021](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/immunology/articles/10.3389/fimmu.2021.669150/full)).

### Bifidobacterium

Bifidobacterium species, from the phylum Actinobacteria, ferment carbohydrates to produce lactic acid and SCFAs, maintaining gut acidity and inhibiting pathogens ([Cancer Biology & Medicine, 2026](https://www.cancerbiomed.org/content/early/2026/01/29/j.issn.2095-3941.2025.0347)). Different strains have distinct roles in cancer immunotherapy:

| Strain | Mechanism | Observed Effect |
|--------|-----------|-----------------|
| *B. longum* 420 | Delivers WT1 tumor antigen with anti-PD-1 | Improves survival in RCC mouse models |
| *B. longum* RAPO | Increases NK cells and CD8+/CD4+ T cells; inhibits M2 macrophage polarization | Reduces tumor burden in breast cancer models |
| *B. infantis* | Modulates PD-L1 to enhance Treg function via PI3K–Akt–mTOR pathway | Modulates immune tolerance |

([Cancer Biology & Medicine, 2026](https://www.cancerbiomed.org/content/early/2026/01/29/j.issn.2095-3941.2025.0347))

A landmark 2015 study by Sivan et al. demonstrated that oral administration of Bifidobacterium enhanced the anti-tumor efficacy of PD-L1 inhibitors by promoting dendritic cell maturation and increasing tumor-specific CD8+ T cell activity ([npj Biofilms and Microbiomes, 2025](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41522-025-00786-8)).

### Other Beneficial Genera

Beyond Lactobacillus and Bifidobacterium, butyrate-producing genera such as *Faecalibacterium prausnitzii*, *Roseburia*, and *Eubacterium rectale* are increasingly recognized as beneficial. These taxa are less abundant in CRC patients, and their restoration through prebiotic supplementation is a promising therapeutic strategy ([Frontiers in Microbiology, 2026](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/microbiology/articles/10.3389/fmicb.2026.1774501/full)).

## Prebiotics: Definition and Mechanisms

Prebiotics are non-digestible compounds that selectively stimulate the growth and activity of beneficial bacteria in the colon. Fructooligosaccharides (FOS) and galactooligosaccharides (GOS) are FDA-approved prebiotics that improve probiotic function by selectively stimulating beneficial microbes ([Journal of Pure and Applied Microbiology, 2024](https://microbiologyjournal.org/influence-of-prebiotic-fructooligosaccharides-on-the-growth-of-probiotic-lactobacillus-spp-to-produce-postbiotic-short-chain-fatty-acids-evaluated-using-gas-chromatography)).

### SCFA Production as the Central Mechanism

The primary mechanistic link between prebiotics and CRC prevention is the bacterial fermentation of dietary fiber into SCFAs—acetate, propionate, and butyrate. Butyrate is particularly significant: it serves as the primary energy source for colonocytes, reinforces epithelial integrity, and exerts anti-inflammatory and anti-carcinogenic effects ([Frontiers in Microbiology, 2026](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/microbiology/articles/10.3389/fmicb.2026.1774501/full)). Molecularly, butyrate acts as a histone deacetylase (HDAC) inhibitor, paradoxically stimulating proliferation of healthy colorectal epithelial cells while inhibiting cancerous cells through epigenetic promotion of tumor suppressors and inhibition of proto-oncogenes ([Frontiers in Microbiology, 2026](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/microbiology/articles/10.3389/fmicb.2026.1774501/full)).

Prebiotic FOS specifically stimulates *Lactobacillus* spp. growth and production of postbiotic butyric acid, as confirmed by gas chromatography studies ([Journal of Pure and Applied Microbiology, 2024](https://microbiologyjournal.org/influence-of-prebiotic-fructooligosaccharides-on-the-growth-of-probiotic-lactobacillus-spp-to-produce-postbiotic-short-chain-fatty-acids-evaluated-using-gas-chromatography)). Butyrate also enhances chemotherapy efficacy: in mice, butyrate supplementation improved the efficacy of oxaliplatin through HDAC inhibition and increased transcription of IL-12 signaling pathway genes, resulting in enhanced CD8+ T cell activation ([Frontiers in Microbiology, 2026](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/microbiology/articles/10.3389/fmicb.2026.1774501/full)).

### Clinical Evidence: The CAPP2 Trial

The CAPP2 trial—a randomized, placebo-controlled study in Lynch syndrome patients—provides nuanced evidence on prebiotic fiber. Daily resistant starch (30 g) did not reduce colorectal cancer risk after 20 years of follow-up (52 cases in the resistant starch group vs. 53 in placebo). However, it significantly reduced non-colorectal Lynch-associated cancers (27 vs. 48), particularly upper GI cancers (5 vs. 21, including stomach, duodenal, bile duct, and pancreatic cancers) ([Facing Our Risk, 2022](https://www.facingourrisk.org/XRAY/resistant-starch-and-cancer-risk); [Cancerworld Magazine, 2022](https://cancerworld.net/resistant-starch-banana-cuts-hereditary-cancer-risk)). This suggests that resistant starch's protective effects may be tissue-specific, and that fermentation-derived SCFAs may offer systemic anti-cancer benefits beyond the colon.

## Pathogenic Gut Bacteria and Their Toxic Metabolites

Three bacterial pathogens have emerged as the most consistently implicated in CRC pathogenesis: *Fusobacterium nucleatum*, pks+ *Escherichia coli*, and enterotoxigenic *Bacteroides fragilis* (ETBF).

### Fusobacterium nucleatum

*F. nucleatum* is a Gram-negative oral anaerobe that ectopically colonizes the lower gastrointestinal tract under pathological conditions ([ecancer, 2025](https://ecancer.org/en/news/26592-fusobacterium-nucleatum-in-colorectal-cancer-ally-mechanism-and-targeted-therapy-strategies)). Its abundance in CRC tumor tissue is significantly higher than in normal mucosa, and high intratumoral levels correlate with advanced stage, recurrence, metastasis, and poor prognosis ([Frontiers in Microbiology, 2025](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/microbiology/articles/10.3389/fmicb.2025.1652702/full)).

**Pathogenic mechanisms:**

- **FadA adhesin**: Binds E-cadherin on colonocytes, disrupts adherens junctions, and triggers β-catenin nuclear translocation, activating oncogenic transcriptional programs ([npj Biofilms and Microbiomes, 2025](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41522-025-00883-8)).
- **Fap2 adhesin**: Binds the Gal-GalNAc receptor overexpressed on cancer cells and interacts with the human inhibitory receptor TIGIT, protecting tumors from immune cell attack ([npj Biofilms and Microbiomes, 2025](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41522-025-00883-8)).
- **TLR4/NF-κB signaling**: Activates pro-inflammatory cytokines including IL-6 and IL-8, sustaining a tumor-promoting inflammatory environment ([npj Biofilms and Microbiomes, 2025](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41522-025-00883-8)).
- **Chemotherapy resistance**: *F. nucleatum* promotes CRC resistance by activating autophagy and inhibiting pyroptosis and ferroptosis, and via exosomal hsa_circ_0004085-mediated endoplasmic reticulum stress ([Frontiers in Microbiology, 2025](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/microbiology/articles/10.3389/fmicb.2025.1652702/full)).

Subspecies-level differences matter: *F. animalis* is linked to higher CRC-specific mortality and specific somatic mutation patterns, suggesting precision approaches may require subspecies identification ([Frontiers in Microbiology, 2025](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/microbiology/articles/10.3389/fmicb.2025.1652702/full)). NCI-funded research has further pinpointed the Fna C2 subtype as a key cancer-fueling culprit, demonstrating its survival in acidic conditions mimicking the stomach and its ability to increase precancerous adenomas in mice ([National Cancer Institute, 2024](https://www.cancer.gov/news-events/cancer-currents-blog/2024/colorectal-cancer-fna-c2-bacteria)).

### pks+ Escherichia coli

pks+ *E. coli* harbors the *pks* island, a suite of *clb* genes encoding the biosynthesis of colibactin—a genotoxin that alkylates DNA and generates interstrand crosslinks ([npj Biofilms and Microbiomes, 2025](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41522-025-00883-8)). This induces DNA double-strand breaks and produces characteristic SBS-pks and ID-pks mutational signatures found in human colorectal cancers, making colibactin one of the few bacterially derived agents with a defined mutational imprint in cancer genomes ([npj Biofilms and Microbiomes, 2025](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41522-025-00883-8)). Approximately 20% of healthy humans carry this bacterium, and it can promote CRC when mice are fed a low-carbohydrate, low-fiber diet, suggesting that diet strongly modulates its pathogenic potential.

Critically, colibactin tolerance is not static: chronic exposure selects for clones with restored homologous recombination proficiency, conferring resistance to DNA-damaging agents such as irinotecan and its active metabolite SN38 ([npj Biofilms and Microbiomes, 2025](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41522-025-00883-8)). This positions pks+ *E. coli* as both an initiator and a contributor to chemoresistance.

### Enterotoxigenic Bacteroides fragilis (ETBF)

ETBF secretes the *B. fragilis* toxin (BFT), which cleaves E-cadherin, activates NF-κB, and drives pro-inflammatory cytokine release ([npj Biofilms and Microbiomes, 2025](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41522-025-00883-8)). A 2025 study demonstrated that *B. fragilis* abundance is significantly higher in chemotherapy non-responders and correlates with poorer prognosis. Mechanistically, a membrane lipoprotein from the SusD/RagB family binds Notch1 receptors on cancer cells, activating the Notch1 pathway and inducing epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition, which underlies chemoresistance ([Biocodex Microbiota Institute, 2025](https://www.biocodexmicrobiotainstitute.com/en/pro/phage-therapy-new-way-restore-effectiveness-chemotherapy)).

## Clinical Evidence for Probiotics in CRC Management

### Postoperative Outcomes

A meta-analysis of 21 studies found that probiotics, particularly Lactobacillus and Bifidobacterium combinations, significantly reduced postoperative infections in colorectal cancer surgery (relative risk 0.54; 95% CI 0.45–0.65) and shortened hospital stay, whereas *Saccharomyces boulardii* alone did not show benefit ([Oncology Letters, 2025](https://www.spandidos-publications.com/10.3892/ol.2025.15261)). This is among the strongest clinical evidence supporting probiotic use in the perioperative CRC setting.

### Immunotherapy Enhancement

A 2025 systematic review and meta-analysis in *Frontiers in Immunology* found that probiotic supplementation improved response rate, overall survival, progression-free survival, and tumor remission in cancer patients receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors, with the benefit particularly pronounced in antibiotic-exposed patients ([Frontiers in Immunology, 2025](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/immunology/articles/10.3389/fimmu.2025.1538969/full)).

A 2025 quasi-experimental study in metastatic colorectal cancer found that adding probiotics to immune checkpoint inhibitors and chemotherapy:

- Improved survival at 6 months, 1 year, and 2 years
- Increased beneficial *Bifidobacterium* and *Lactobacillus*
- Reduced harmful *Enterococcus* and *E. coli*
- Improved intestinal barrier markers
- Boosted CD3+ and CD4+ T cells and CD4+/CD8+ ratio
- Reduced chemotherapy-related GI complications

([EMJ Reviews, 2025](https://www.emjreviews.com/gastroenterology/news/probiotic-therapy-boosts-survival-and-gut-health-in-metastatic-colorectal-cancer))

### Cautionary Evidence

Not all probiotic effects are beneficial in the immunotherapy context. A study of melanoma patients treated with ICIs found that higher dietary fiber intake was associated with significantly improved progression-free survival, particularly in patients who consumed adequate fiber *without* probiotic use. Low-fiber diets or probiotics (*Bifidobacterium longum* or LGG) impaired anti-PD-1-based treatment responses in some contexts ([Oncology Letters, 2024](https://www.spandidos-publications.com/10.3892/ol.2024.14221)). This underscores that probiotic timing, strain selection, and dietary context matter substantially. An ongoing Mayo Clinic trial (NCT06508034) is testing VSL#3® 450B for prevention of immune checkpoint inhibitor-induced colitis, which occurs in up to 45% of immunotherapy patients ([CenterWatch, 2026](https://www.centerwatch.com/clinical-trials/listings/NCT06508034/probiotics-for-the-prevention-of-immunotherapy-induced-colitis-in-patients-receiving-immunotherapy)).

## Emerging Targeted Therapies: Bacteriophages

Given the collateral damage of broad-spectrum antibiotics, bacteriophage therapy has emerged as a precision approach to deplete oncogenic bacteria while sparing beneficial commensals ([PhageCocktails, 2026](https://phagecocktails.com/applications/fusobacterium-colorectal-cancer)). Preclinical developments include:

| Approach | Mechanism | Outcome |
|----------|-----------|---------|
| Phage-guided irinotecan nanoparticles | Fn-binding phage conjugated to irinotecan-loaded dextran nanoparticles | Depletes *F. nucleatum*, overcomes chemoresistance; negligible toxicity in piglets |
| M13@Ag hybrid | M13 phage coated with silver nanoparticles | Clears gut Fn, reduces MDSCs, synergizes with anti-PD-1 and FOLFIRI |
| Lytic phage ØTCUFN3 | Naturally lytic Fn phage | Inhibits Fn-induced CRC cell proliferation and EMT |
| Phage FNU1 | Targets *F. nucleatum* subsp. *polymorphum* | Negates Fn-induced growth, migration, autophagy, and chemoresistance in colon and gastric cancer cells |
| Phage VA7 | Targets *B. fragilis* | Reverses chemoresistance in CRC mice |

([PhageCocktails, 2026](https://phagecocktails.com/applications/fusobacterium-colorectal-cancer); [Frontiers in Cellular and Infection Microbiology, 2025](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/cellular-and-infection-microbiology/articles/10.3389/fcimb.2025.1721411/full); [Biocodex Microbiota Institute, 2025](https://www.biocodexmicrobiotainstitute.com/en/pro/phage-therapy-new-way-restore-effectiveness-chemotherapy))

These approaches reframe Fn-positive CRC as a potentially "treatable infection" layered onto standard oncology care, though as of 2026 no registered human clinical trial yet evaluates anti-Fn phage therapy for CRC ([PhageCocktails, 2026](https://phagecocktails.com/applications/fusobacterium-colorectal-cancer)).

## Dietary Implications and Practical Recommendations

The evidence converges on several actionable dietary principles:

1. **Prioritize fiber-rich, prebiotic foods.** Resistant starch (found in bananas, potatoes, grains, beans, and peas) and fermentable fibers (inulin, FOS) are fermented by gut bacteria into SCFAs with anti-inflammatory and anti-carcinogenic effects ([Frontiers in Microbiology, 2026](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/microbiology/articles/10.3389/fmicb.2026.1774501/full)). The University of Toronto team is actively investigating which fiber types most effectively reduce pks+ *E. coli*, having shown in mice that low-carbohydrate, low-fiber diets promote pks+ *E. coli*-mediated tumorigenesis.

2. **Avoid sustained low-fiber, low-carbohydrate diets.** These diets create a permissive environment for pathogenic bacteria, as demonstrated by the Toronto group's mouse studies showing accelerated tumor development in mice carrying DNA repair gene mutations.

3. **Select probiotic strains based on evidence.** Lactobacillus and Bifidobacterium combinations have the strongest clinical support for reducing postoperative infections (RR 0.54) and improving immunotherapy outcomes. However, the melanoma data caution against indiscriminate probiotic use during immunotherapy, particularly with low fiber intake.

4. **Consider synbiotics.** Combining probiotics with compatible prebiotics enhances effects; for example, *Lactobacillus plantarum* with inulin markedly increases butyrate-producing taxa and suppresses tumor formation in preclinical studies ([Frontiers in Nutrition, 2025](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/nutrition/articles/10.3389/fnut.2025.1693875/full)).

## Conclusion and Perspective

The evidence overwhelmingly supports the gut microbiota as a critical mediator of CRC pathogenesis, treatment response, and prevention. Based on the synthesized findings, I hold the view that the most promising clinical strategy is a **precision "microbiome adjuvant" approach**: rather than indiscriminate probiotic supplementation, oncologic care should incorporate microbiome profiling to identify patients with high *F. nucleatum*, pks+ *E. coli*, or ETBF burden, and then apply targeted interventions—whether specific probiotic strains, prebiotic fibers, or ultimately phage therapy—to restore a protective microbial ecosystem.

The strongest actionable insight for daily dietary practice is that **dietary fiber is non-negotiable**. The CAPP2 trial's finding that resistant starch reduced upper GI cancers by roughly 60% (5 vs. 21 cases) is a striking signal that microbial fermentation products exert protective effects beyond the colon itself. Conversely, the low-carbohydrate, low-fiber diet experiments demonstrate that modern dietary patterns can actively promote genotoxic bacterial outgrowth. For the general population and for CRC patients alike, a high-fiber diet rich in diverse plant substrates, combined with evidence-based probiotic strains (Lactobacillus and Bifidobacterium), represents the most robust strategy currently available. The future lies in phage-based precision therapies that can dismantle the oncobacterium-tumor nexus without the collateral damage of antibiotics—transforming CRC from purely a cancer to a condition where the microbiome is both a biomarker and a therapeutic target.

# 房地产行业可持续发展的动力与未来十年政策路径研究

## 摘要

中国房地产市场已进入存量主导的新阶段，行业正经历从“规模扩张”向“高质量发展”的历史性转型。本报告基于2024—2026年政策文件、行业数据与专家研究，系统分析了房地产行业可持续发展的核心动力，并从政策导向、资金支持与制度重构三个维度，展望未来十年促进行业有序、良性发展的路径。研究发现：**改善性需求、城市更新与“好房子”建设构成需求侧三大动力；保障性住房再贷款、专项债与REITs构成资金侧三大支柱；现房销售、项目公司制与主办银行制构成制度侧三大基石。** 三者协同推进，将推动房地产行业从“高杠杆、高周转”的旧模式，转向“高质量、高效率、高价值”的新发展范式。

---

## 一、引言：存量时代的行业转型背景

2025年，中国房地产市场呈现“总量下行、结构分化”的显著特征。房地产开发投资从2021年峰值14.76万亿元回落至2025年前11个月的7.86万亿元，降幅超过40%；新建商品房销售面积从17.94亿平方米降至7.87亿平方米，降幅超过50%；新开工面积从22.72亿平方米降至5.35亿平方米，降幅超过70%（[中国房地产报，2026](https://www.peopleapp.com/rmharticle/30051188122)）。这些数据表明，行业已告别高速增长阶段，进入深度调整与模式重构的关键时期。

清华大学房地产研究中心主任吴璟指出，我国房地产市场进入存量主导的新阶段并非短期市场波动所致，而是市场发展到一定阶段的必然趋势。当前全国城镇存量住房规模大，改善性需求成为市场主体，多数改善性需求通过“一买一卖”的置换模式实现，这一市场结构决定了房地产市场从增量扩张到存量提质的路径转换（[新华网，2025](https://www.news.cn/fortune/20251225/2a793445e02645379c13754b1c0a38c0/c.html)）。

在此背景下，理解房地产行业可持续发展的动力来源，以及国家未来十年的政策、资金与导向安排，对于行业参与者、政策制定者与投资者均具有重要的现实意义。

---

## 二、房地产行业可持续发展的核心动力

### 2.1 需求侧动力：改善性需求与“好房子”建设

**改善性需求已成为市场主导力量。** “十五五”规划建议首次明确提出“因城施策增加改善性住房供给”，标志着政策层面对改善性需求的正式确认与支持（[财联社，2025](https://www.cls.cn/detail/2183989)）。中指研究院监测数据显示，2025年前三季度，重点30城120—144平方米住房占比提升至30%，大户型产品成为新房市场主流；上海、南京、长沙等城市120—144平方米户型占比提升幅度尤为明显（[财联社，2025](https://www.cls.cn/detail/2183989)）。

**“好房子”建设从概念走向系统落地。** 2025年3月，《政府工作报告》首次提出推动建设“安全、舒适、绿色、智慧”的“好房子”；5月1日，国家标准《住宅项目规范》正式实施，要求新建住宅层高不低于3.0米，较原有标准提高20厘米（[证券日报，2025](http://epaper.zqrb.cn/html/2025-06/11/content_1156059.htm?div=-1)）。上海交通大学教授陈杰指出，“好房子”建设通过有效激活住房改善需求，带动家电家具家装、物业服务、社区商业、健康养老等上下游消费，是统筹内需扩大和供给侧结构性改革的关键一环（[上海交通大学中国城市治理研究院，2026](https://ciug.sjtu.edu.cn/Cn/Show?w=36&p=4&f=6674)）。

然而，“好房子”建设仍面临现实挑战：新标准带来建安成本提升，需平衡品质与成本；市场存在概念泛化现象，智能家居标准体系不完善；长期“重建设、轻运营”导致交付后维护能力不足（[红网，2026](https://zfhcxjs.rednet.cn/content/646042/56/16169238.html)）。

### 2.2 供给侧动力：城市更新与存量盘活

**城市更新已从地方探索跃升为国家战略。** 2026年《政府工作报告》将城市更新置于“推动新型城镇化和区域协调发展”的核心框架下，标志着城市发展模式正从“增量扩张”转向“存量盘活”（[中国人民大学国家发展与战略研究院，2026](http://nads.ruc.edu.cn/zkdt/xzgd/3d86d5efd1c9486b89de4875b010d019.htm)）。国务院印发的《城市更新“十五五”规划》明确提出，到2030年城市开发建设方式转型初见成效，城市更新将成为城市开发建设的主导方式（[中国政府网，2026](https://www.mee.gov.cn/zcwj/gwywj/202606/t20260602_1157796.shtml)）。

**存量盘活是房企转型的重要方向。** 国金证券研报指出，城市更新通过“拆旧建新”释放核心区域土地，是满足积压改善需求的关键路径。以上海为例，非公开市场拿地占比从2023年的10%上升到2025年的30.6%，黄浦、徐汇等城市更新力度较大区域，通过非公开市场成交的地块面积占比超过80%（[金融界，2026](https://m.jrj.com.cn/madapter/stock/2026/06/02080657294023.shtml)）。

### 2.3 资金侧动力：多元化融资体系构建

**保障性住房再贷款提供低成本资金支持。** 2024年5月，中国人民银行设立3000亿元保障性住房再贷款，利率1.75%，期限1年可展期4次，发放对象为21家全国性银行，央行按贷款本金60%发放再贷款，预计带动银行贷款5000亿元（[新华网，2024](http://www.news.cn/politics/20240517/f66afea0f3184219ad67b67340658f6d/c.html)）。2024年9月，央行进一步将资金支持比例由60%提高至100%，增强了对银行和收购主体的市场化激励（[新华网，2024](https://www.news.cn/fortune/20241228/63a8918108864b1797cfab2678220cd9/c.html)）。

**专项债与REITs拓展长期资金渠道。** 2025年，各地城市更新相关专项债发行超3500亿元；2026年一季度发行接近1200亿元，已达去年全年的三分之一（[人民网，2026](http://finance.people.com.cn/n1/2026/0602/c1004-40732249.html)）。2025年12月，国家发改委将基础设施REITs扩围至城市更新项目、商业办公设施、酒店、体育场馆等领域，为存量资产盘活提供了资本市场退出通道（[金融界，2026](https://m.jrj.com.cn/madapter/stock/2026/06/02080657294023.shtml)）。

## 三、未来十年政策导向：从“三高”到“三新”

### 3.1 政策框架：“控增量、去库存、优供给”

2026年全国住房城乡建设工作会议明确了房地产政策的三大重点：**因城施策控增量、去库存、优供给**（[石家庄市住建局，2025](https://zjj.sjz.gov.cn/columns/0baeb259-d051-49c6-8b44-d1e309fedf36/202512/25/faf749b7-22f9-425f-b478-ef69d87e1c73.html)）。

- **控增量**：房地产过剩城市严控新增房地产用地，重点结合城市更新、城中村改造盘活存量用地，从源头控制新增供给（[新华网，2025](https://www.news.cn/fortune/20251225/2a793445e02645379c13754b1c0a38c0/c.html)）。
- **去库存**：推动收购存量商品房用作保障性住房、安置房、人才房等，实现“去库存”与“补保障”双重突破。浙江、四川、山东、湖南等省份已发行专项债用于收购存量商品房并转化为保障房（[新华网，2025](https://www.news.cn/fortune/20251225/2a793445e02645379c13754b1c0a38c0/c.html)）。
- **优供给**：围绕“好标准、好设计、好材料、好建造、好运维”的“五好”要求，推动“好房子”建设从示范试点迈向全面普及（[新华网，2025](https://www.news.cn/fortune/20251225/2a793445e02645379c13754b1c0a38c0/c.html)）。

### 3.2 制度重构：项目公司制、主办银行制与现房销售制

房地产发展新模式的核心制度安排包括三大支柱（[财联社，2025](https://www.cls.cn/detail/2183989)）：

| 制度 | 核心内容 | 政策目标 |
|------|---------|---------|
| 项目公司制 | 做实房地产开发项目公司独立法人地位 | 防止资金抽逃，夯实项目风险隔离 |
| 主办银行制 | 推行项目资金封闭运转的融资模式 | 确保项目合理融资与如期交付 |
| 现房销售制 | 推进“所见即所得”的销售模式 | 从根本上防范交付风险 |

**现房销售是其中最具深远影响的变革。** 2024年，全国房地产开发企业到位资金中定金及预收款占比达31.2%（[21世纪经济报道，2025](https://www.21jingji.com/article/20250515/4a7f3f7d5ae3932e84ff8a35085c2be3.html)）。若转向现房销售，这部分零成本资金将消失，房企需以有息负债替代，导致杠杆成本上升。据中信建投研究，A股96家上市房企预收账款占总负债比重近五年稳定在27%—30%之间，若完全由有息负债替代，杠杆成本将明显提升（[中信建投，2018](http://pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H3_AP201809291204782292_1.pdf)）。

然而，中央和地方政府正有力有序推进现房销售。住建部已将其列为2025年重点工作之一，长沙、昆明、山东、浙江等地已明确推进，深圳在土地出让中设置“竞现房面积”或要求全部现房销售，海南已实施全域现房销售（[21世纪经济报道，2025](https://www.21jingji.com/article/20250515/4a7f3f7d5ae3932e84ff8a35085c2be3.html)）。

---

## 四、资金支持体系：多层次、全周期、可持续

### 4.1 保障性住房再贷款与收储机制

保障性住房再贷款政策建立了“央行—商业银行—地方国企”的三级资金传导机制。收购主体由城市政府选定，该国企及所属集团不得涉及地方政府隐性债务，不得为地方政府融资平台，同时应具备银行授信要求和授信空间（[新华网，2024](http://www.news.cn/politics/20240517/f66afea0f3184219ad67b67340658f6d/c.html)）。租赁住房贷款支持计划的1000亿元额度已并入保障性住房再贷款3000亿元额度之内，8个试点城市政策与全国保持一致（[人民日报海外版，2024](http://paper.people.com.cn/rmrbhwb/html/2024-06/15/content_26063639.htm)）。

截至2024年12月，全国已有上百个城市收购工作专班选定收购主体，70多个城市公开发布房源征集公告（[新华网，2024](https://www.news.cn/fortune/20241228/63a8918108864b1797cfab2678220cd9/c.html)）。

### 4.2 专项债与“债贷组合”模式

专项债支持城市更新项目始于2019年，2023—2025年城市更新相关专项债占比约为12%，2026年1—5月小幅提升至13.3%（[金融界，2026](https://m.jrj.com.cn/madapter/stock/2026/06/02080657294023.shtml)）。2024年12月，国务院办公厅“52号文”将城市更新纳入专项债用作项目资本金范围，2025年专项债用作城市更新项目资本金的规模约177亿元（[金融界，2026](https://m.jrj.com.cn/madapter/stock/2026/06/02080657294023.shtml)）。

在收储领域，截至2025年9月，全国已落地537个专项债收储项目，用于支持“两个领域”的专项债使用规模为1466亿元（[证券时报，2025](https://www.stcn.com/article/detail/3322301.html)）。专家建议建立“特别国债+专项债+再贷款”的多维融资机制，针对保障房项目20年以上的现金流周期，发行30年期特别国债作为主要资金，并通过REITs实现资金退出（[证券时报，2025](https://www.stcn.com/article/detail/3322301.html)）。

### 4.3 政策性金融与城市更新融资创新

国家开发银行是支持城市更新的主力银行。2025年，国开行向城市更新领域发放贷款7863亿元，重点支持城镇老旧小区整治改造、老旧街区厂区更新改造、城中村改造等领域（[人民网，2026](http://finance.people.com.cn/n1/2026/0602/c1004-40732249.html)）。国开行不仅提供长期贷款，还提供“融资+融智”服务，帮助项目在规划阶段算清投入和收益，通过物业费、停车费及周边商业收入等实现“微利可持续”的改造模式（[新华网，2025](http://www.news.cn/house/20250630/a835e8a0e4b9460da7a5c51f7738fddb/c.html)）。

江苏省出台的“城新贷”政策通过财政贴息引导金融和社会资本支持城市更新，国开行已有34个历史文化保护项目纳入贴息项目库（[新华网，2025](http://www.news.cn/house/20250630/a835e8a0e4b9460da7a5c51f7738fddb/c.html)）。

## 五、行业格局演变：分化、转型与重构

### 5.1 市场分化：城市、产品与企业三重分化

2026年房地产市场呈现“多维度、多层次”的分化格局（[中国房地产报，2026](https://www.peopleapp.com/rmharticle/30051188122)）：

- **城市分化**：都市圈核心城市凭借经济产业优势有望率先企稳，人口流出型三四线城市取决于库存去化情况。
- **产品分化**：“好房子”将主导新建住房市场，按旧标准建成未售出的商品房将失去市场竞争力；刚性需求主要通过存量房和二手房市场满足。
- **企业分化**：央企国企及少数优质民企凭借低融资成本和健康资产负债表拥有战略主动权；高杠杆、出险房企面临退出。

### 5.2 企业转型路径：三大方向

未来房企转型方向可归纳为三类（[金融界，2026](https://m.jrj.com.cn/madapter/stock/2026/06/02080657294023.shtml)）：

1. **高品质开发商**：通过城市更新获取核心区域土地，建设“新好房”，满足改善需求。
2. **不动产开发运营商**：参与存量土地和房产盘活，转向轻资产运营模式，通过租金收入和REITs实现资金循环。
3. **专业服务商**：提供物业服务和资产管理，在“好房子”保值增值中发挥关键作用。

---

## 六、结论与展望

房地产行业可持续发展的动力已从过去的“土地红利+人口红利+金融杠杆”转向“品质提升+存量运营+制度创新”。未来十年，国家将通过以下路径促进行业有序、良性发展：

**第一，政策导向上，** 坚持“房住不炒”定位，以“控增量、去库存、优供给”为主线，推动房地产从“经济调控工具”回归“民生本源”（[毕马威，2026](https://www.grandall.com.cn/ghsd/info.aspx?itemid=34422)）。“十五五”规划将“推动房地产高质量发展”置于民生保障板块，核心关键词从“增加供给”转向“优化供给”“高质量发展”“新模式”（[新华网，2025](http://www.xinhuanet.com/house/20251110/4115c21e93b34715aa0e9f7603eb1988/c.html)）。

**第二，资金支持上，** 构建“央行再贷款+专项债+REITs+政策性金融”的多元化融资体系，通过“债贷组合”“特别国债+专项债+再贷款”等创新模式，解决城市更新和保障房收储的资金瓶颈。城市更新有望成为“十五五”时期信贷投放的重点领域（[金融界，2026](https://m.jrj.com.cn/madapter/stock/2026/06/02080657294023.shtml)）。

**第三，制度构建上，** 以项目公司制、主办银行制、现房销售制三大制度为支柱，建立房屋全生命周期安全管理制度，推动房地产从“造房卖房”的单一模式转向“投建管运”的全周期模式。

需要指出的是，房地产行业的转型并非一蹴而就。正如中欧国际工商学院教授盛松成所言，“十五五”规划为行业明确了“先化风险、再谋新路”的清晰路径，须以稳住市场为前提，以构建新模式为核心，以提升居住品质为根本（[中欧国际工商学院，2026](https://cn.ceibs.edu/media/press-clippings/faculty/28539)）。预计地产行业在底部区间实现筑底后，“十五五”中后期可能出现企稳修复的迹象（[财联社，2025](https://www.cls.cn/detail/2183989)）。

未来十年，房地产行业将不再是粗放增长的“发动机”，而是精细化运营的“稳定器”。那些能够顺应品质升级趋势、把握存量运营机遇、构建全周期服务能力的企业，将在新一轮行业格局中胜出。

article:
# 非接触式感知领域最优算法策略与输入信号评估：综合研究报告

## 1. 引言

非接触式感知利用无线信号在传播过程中受人体或物体影响而产生的变化，实现手势识别、活动识别、定位追踪乃至生理监测。与摄像头相比，它不依赖光线、可穿透遮挡、隐私侵入性较低；与可穿戴设备相比，它无需用户佩戴任何终端。当前研究主要覆盖 WiFi、毫米波、太赫兹（THz）等频段，并逐步向 6G 集成感知与通信（ISAC）演进。然而，实际部署仍面临核心瓶颈：跨环境、跨用户、跨位置的领域偏移，信号质量对硬件配置的依赖，以及感知精度与隐私保护之间的平衡。

本报告基于最新研究文献，系统梳理当前非接触式感知领域表现优异的算法策略，重点评估不同输入信号（CSI、RSSI、BVP/DFS、角度特征等）的适用性与可达到的准确率，并给出综合性判断。

## 2. 输入信号类型及其特征

### 2.1 CSI（信道状态信息）

CSI 是 WiFi 物理层细粒度信息，可在多个子载波上提供幅度和相位响应，对微小人体运动（如呼吸、手势）高度敏感，因此成为非接触式感知的核心数据源 ([Tech Science Press](https://www.techscience.com/cmc/v86n1/64495/html))。但 CSI 对随机相位失真非常敏感，例如时钟不同步和硬件不连续会造成相位畸变，必须经过预处理（如 Doppler-delay 二维 FFT、CASR、去噪与变换）才能稳定用于感知 ([Nature](https://www.nature.com/articles/s44459-026-00053-y))。

### 2.2 RSSI（接收信号强度指示）

RSSI 是粗粒度信号强度，容易获取且隐私风险较低。WiRSSI 系统仅用 RSSI 即可实现被动追踪和手势识别，但精度明显低于 CSI：其被动定位中位 XY 误差为 0.784–0.905 m，而 CSI 方法为 0.514–0.599 m。因此 RSSI 更适合低成本、隐私敏感且对精度要求不高的场景 ([Nature](https://www.nature.com/articles/s44459-026-00053-y))。

### 2.3 BVP 与 DFS（身体坐标速度轮廓与多普勒频移）

Widar3.0 是当前最大规模的 WiFi 手势感知数据集之一，包含 258K 个手势实例、总计 8,620 分钟、来自 75 个域，同时提供原始 CSI/RSSI 以及多普勒频移（DFS）和身体坐标速度轮廓（BVP）特征 ([IEEE DataPort](https://ieee-dataport.org/open-access/widar-30-wifi-based-activity-recognition-dataset))。BVP 将 WiFi 信号映射到身体坐标系中的速度分布，具有环境与位置无关性。但 BVP 提取需要至少三个接收器，大大限制了单节点部署 ([WiGr 论文](https://zhang-xie.github.io/papers/WiGr_zhang.pdf))。此外，这类高层特征通常需要高分辨率 CSI 或特定多天线配置 ([awesome-wireless-sensing-generalization](https://github.com/aiotgroup/awesome-wireless-sensing-generalization))。

### 2.4 角度特征（AoA/ADoA）

到达角（AoA）和到达角差（ADoA）提供精确的空间几何信息，对轨迹跟踪和身份识别鲁棒，但其性能高度依赖天线阵列的校准与布局。若阵列标定不精确，角度特征误差会显著放大 ([awesome-wireless-sensing-generalization](https://github.com/aiotgroup/awesome-wireless-sensing-generalization))。

| 输入信号 | 信息粒度 | 主要优点 | 主要局限 | 典型任务 |
|---------|---------|---------|----------|----------|
| CSI 幅度/相位 | 细粒度 | 敏感度高、频率分集 | 相位失真、跨域偏移 | 手势/活动/定位 |
| RSSI | 粗粒度 | 低开销、隐私友好 | 精度低 | 低成本追踪/检测 |
| BVP/DFS | 高层物理量 | 域无关、环境鲁棒 | 需多接收器 | 跨域手势识别 |
| AoA/ADoA | 空间几何 | 精确、鲁棒 | 校准敏感 | 定位/身份识别 |

## 3. 当前最优算法策略分类评估

### 3.1 基于域无关特征的学习

Widar3.0 是这一策略的代表。它在 SenseFi 基准中采用 BVP 输入，尺寸为 22×20×20，共 22 类手势，标准训练/测试划分包含 34,926 和 8,726 个样本，为深度学习模型提供了可复现的评估平台 ([SenseFi GitHub](https://github.com/xyanchen/WiFi-CSI-Sensing-Benchmark/blob/main/README.md))。基于 BVP 的模型在领域内任务上已达到较高精度，但多接收器限制使其难以在普通家庭场景推广。相比之下，使用原始 CSI 幅度和相位在部署灵活性上更优，且仍能取得高精度 ([WiGr 论文](https://zhang-xie.github.io/papers/WiGr_zhang.pdf))。此外，设计不变指示量（如相位差、IQ 曲率）以绕过域偏移，是面向资源受限和可解释性系统的实用思路 ([awesome-wireless-sensing-generalization](https://github.com/aiotgroup/awesome-wireless-sensing-generalization))。

### 3.2 深度学习与跨域泛化

深度学习已成为无线感知的主流工具。ML/AI 相比传统模型驱动算法，能更好地应对模型失配、高维输入和时变环境，因为它们可以直接从数据中学习复杂映射，而不依赖理想化假设 ([Chalmers](https://research.chalmers.se/publication/551083/file/551083_Fulltext.pdf))。但单纯增加模型容量会导致严重过拟合：例如在 Widar 数据上，ResNet 的训练精度可接近 100%，测试精度却很低。这证明必须在训练策略中引入跨域机制，如迁移学习、无监督学习和领域自适应 ([SenseFi 论文](https://www.pure.ed.ac.uk/ws/files/334748124/SenseFi_YANG_DOA06022023_VOR_CC_BY.pdf))。

WiGr 系统采用改进的双路径原型网络，输入为 CSI 幅度和相位。在 Widar3.0 领域内测试中达到 92.7%；跨环境下，随着支持样本从 1-shot 到 4-shot 增加，准确率从 60% 升至 83%；跨用户 4-shot 达 89%；跨位置在更多支持样本下约 75%；跨朝向从 75% 提升至 84%。这些结果表明，结合少样本学习的原型网络是当前 CSI 跨域手势识别的最强基线之一 ([WiGr 论文](https://zhang-xie.github.io/papers/WiGr_zhang.pdf))。

### 3.3 传统高分辨率参数估计算法

在角度/距离估计任务中，子空间类算法（MUSIC、ESPRIT）和波束成形类算法（MVDR）仍然占据重要地位。仿真表明，MUSIC 在均匀线阵下比 Root-MUSIC 和 ESPRIT 精度更高，但波束宽度更宽，且对相干源不高效 ([IJRET](https://ijret.org/volumes/2015v04/i06/IJRET20150406098.pdf))。在反射定位（声学/无线）场景中，带有频率平滑的 EB-MVDR 可以达到与 EB-MUSIC 相当的精度，且无需预先已知源数量，因此更适应真实多径环境 ([Eusipco](https://www.eurasip.org/Proceedings/Eusipco/Eusipco2011/papers/1569426749.pdf))。这些算法常作为前端提取角度特征，再供深度学习模型使用。

### 3.4 太赫兹/6G ISAC 中的模型驱动与数据驱动融合

在 THz 频段，超宽带宽导致波束分裂（beam split）：不同子载波上波束指向不同方向；在近场中该现象还具有距离依赖性，使远场校正技术失效 ([THz-ISAC 论文](https://orbilu.uni.lu/bitstream/10993/58263/1/p098_THZ_ISAC_v3.pdf))。经典远场信道估计算法因此不再适用。模型驱动方法中，近场波束分裂感知的 OMP（NB-aware OMP）通过利用角度和距离偏差构造字典，可有效缓解波束分裂影响 ([近场信道估计论文](https://orbilu.uni.lu/bitstream/10993/58266/1/p119_FL_NF_CE_v0.pdf))。另一重要进展是稀疏贝叶斯学习（SBL）：将波束分裂建模为阵列扰动，联合估计 THz 信道与波束分裂，数值仿真显示优于现有方法，且比时间延迟器网络硬件成本更低 ([Herts Research Profiles](https://researchprofiles.herts.ac.uk/en/publications/terahertz-band-channel-and-beam-split-estimation-via-array-pertur))。

### 3.5 6G ISAC 系统级策略与隐私

6G ISAC 不应把每个基站变成独立雷达，而应在现有通信架构上叠加感知能力，重点用于环境背景感知、车辆/固定 UE 感知等规模化场景 ([Samsung Research](https://research.samsung.com/blog/6G-ISAC-Expanding-the-Value-of-Mobile-Networks-Beyond-Connectivity))。感知结果的报告形式（原始样本、延迟-多普勒-角度轮廓、峰值、目标级指标）直接影响开销与隐私风险。尤其 UE 侧上报感知数据时，若包含敏感位置或环境信息，可能造成隐私泄露 ([Samsung Research](https://research.samsung.com/blog/6G-ISAC-Expanding-the-Value-of-Mobile-Networks-Beyond-Connectivity))。毫米波/sub-THz 感知甚至可提取呼吸频率和心率等生理数据，因此隐私设计必须成为算法策略的一部分 ([IACR ePrint](https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1069))。

## 4. 准确率综合评估与比较

下表汇总了代表性方法与输入信号的准确率/误差。需注意各方法任务和评估条件不同，不能直接横向比较。

| 方法 | 输入信号 | 任务 | 准确率/误差 | 条件 |
|------|---------|------|------------|------|
| Widar3.0 + SenseFi 基线 | BVP (22×20×20) | 22 类手势 | 标准化训练/测试集 (34926/8726) | 领域内 |
| WiGr 原型网络 | CSI 幅度+相位 | 22 类手势 | 92.7% (in-domain) | 单域 |
| WiGr | CSI | 跨环境 | 60%–83% (1→4-shot) | Widar3.0 |
| WiGr | CSI | 跨用户 | 最高 89% (4-shot) | Widar3.0 |
| WiGr | CSI | 跨位置 | 约 75%（更多支持样本） | Widar3.0 |
| WiGr | CSI | 跨朝向 | 75%→84% | Widar3.0 |
| WiRSSI | RSSI | 被动定位 | 中位 XY 误差 0.784–0.905 m | 低开销 |
| CSI 方法 | CSI | 被动定位 | 中位 XY 误差 0.514–0.599 m | 高精度 |
| MUSIC vs ESPRIT | 阵列信号 | DOA 估计 | MUSIC 更准确，对相干源不高效 | ULA 仿真 |
| SBL (SBCE) | THz 信道 | 信道+波束分裂估计 | 优于现有方法，硬件成本低 | THz |

数据来源分别为 ([WiGr 论文](https://zhang-xie.github.io/papers/WiGr_zhang.pdf))、([Nature](https://www.nature.com/articles/s44459-026-00053-y))、([IJRET](https://ijret.org/volumes/2015v04/i06/IJRET20150406098.pdf))、([Herts](https://researchprofiles.herts.ac.uk/en/publications/terahertz-band-channel-and-beam-split-estimation-via-array-pertur))。

从表中可以观察到：领域内识别已能达到 90% 以上，但跨域任务仍明显下降。即使是被设计为域无关的 BVP，在更复杂的跨位置/跨环境评估中，也需要较多目标域样本才能达到 75–83%。这表明“域无关特征”并非万能，需与少样本/元学习策略结合。

## 5. 讨论与个人观点

基于上述证据，可以得出几个明确判断。

**第一，没有放之四海而皆准的最优算法，但存在当前最优的组合策略。** 在多接收器可用的基础设施（如智能家居多节点）中，BVP + 深度学习仍是最成熟的域无关方案，因为它在 Widar3.0 上提供了可复现的基准；但在单设备场景（如手机、路由器）中，BVP 不可行，基于原始 CSI 的跨域少样本学习（原型网络、对抗域适应）是更佳选择。

**第二，跨域泛化是衡量算法优劣的核心指标。** 一个模型若只能在训练环境表现良好，就无法真正实用。SenseFi 基准显示 ResNet 等强模型在跨环境测试下崩溃，而 WiGr 通过双路径原型网络和原始 CSI 实现了跨环境 83%、跨用户 89% 的准确率，证明“原始信号 + 巧妙学习策略”可以替代人工设计的域无关特征，且不受多接收器限制。

**第三，THz/6G 领域的最佳实践是物理感知学习。** 稀疏贝叶斯学习和 NB-aware OMP 展现了模型驱动方法在极端物理效应（如近场波束分裂）下的不可替代性；同时，联邦学习等模型无关框架能够在共享原始数据受限时协同训练。这一思路与 WiFi 感知中的“信号处理 + 深度学习”融合形成共鸣。

**第四，隐私与感知精度必须协同设计。** 最优算法不应只追求准确率，还要考虑报告粒度。目标级指标比原始样本/特征级隐私风险低，但精度依赖于前端处理。因此，“在哪一层做感知”成为 6G ISAC 系统设计的决策点。

综合来看，当前非接触式感知领域最值得推荐的算法策略是：**以物理启发的特征/模型为骨架，以数据驱动的跨域学习为引擎，以应用约束（接收器数量、隐私预算、计算资源）为准绳。** 具体而言：使用 CSI 幅度/相位或 BVP 作为输入，采用原型网络/域对抗训练处理领域偏移，并在前端结合 MUSIC/MVDR 或 SBL 等估计器实现参数级感知。这种混合架构既能达到 90% 左右的领域内准确率，也能在跨域场景中保持 80% 左右的表现。

## 6. 结论

本报告系统梳理了非接触式感知领域的最优算法策略与输入信号评估。当前最有效的输入信号包括 CSI、BVP/DFS 和角度特征；CSI 灵活性最高，BVP 域无关性最好但硬件要求高。算法策略上，域无关特征设计、深度跨域学习、传统参数估计和物理感知学习各有所长。综合来看，原始 CSI + 少样本原型网络和 THz 稀疏贝叶斯学习分别是 WiFi 和 6G 频段当前最有前景的方法。未来应在标准化基准、隐私保护机制和轻量化部署方面继续推进。

citations.fact: CSI 是 WiFi 物理层细粒度信息，可在多个子载波上提供幅度和相位响应，对微小人体运动（如呼吸、手势）高度敏感，因此成为非接触式感知的核心数据源
CSI 对随机相位失真非常敏感，例如时钟不同步和硬件不连续会造成相位畸变，必须经过预处理（如 Doppler-delay 二维 FFT、CASR、去噪与变换）才能稳定用于感知
WiRSSI 系统仅用 RSSI 即可实现被动追踪和手势识别，但精度明显低于 CSI：其被动定位中位 XY 误差为 0.784–0.905 m，而 CSI 方法为 0.514–0.599 m。因此 RSSI 更适合低成本、隐私敏感且对精度要求不高的场景
Widar3.0 是当前最大规模的 WiFi 手势感知数据集之一，包含 258K 个手势实例、总计 8,620 分钟、来自 75 个域，同时提供原始 CSI/RSSI 以及多普勒频移（DFS）和身体坐标速度轮廓（BVP）特征
BVP 提取需要至少三个接收器，大大限制了单节点部署
此外，这类高层特征通常需要高分辨率 CSI 或特定多天线配置
若阵列标定不精确，角度特征误差会显著放大
Widar3.0 是这一策略的代表。它在 SenseFi 基准中采用 BVP 输入，尺寸为 22×20×20，共 22 类手势，标准训练/测试划分包含 34,926 和 8,726 个样本，为深度学习模型提供了可复现的评估平台
使用原始 CSI 幅度和相位在部署灵活性上更优，且仍能取得高精度
设计不变指示量（如相位差、IQ 曲率）以绕过域偏移，是面向资源受限和可解释性系统的实用思路
ML/AI 相比传统模型驱动算法，能更好地应对模型失配、高维输入和时变环境，因为它们可以直接从数据中学习复杂映射，而不依赖理想化假设
这证明必须在训练策略中引入跨域机制，如迁移学习、无监督学习和领域自适应
WiGr 系统采用改进的双路径原型网络，输入为 CSI 幅度和相位。在 Widar3.0 领域内测试中达到 92.7%；跨环境下，随着支持样本从 1-shot 到 4-shot 增加，准确率从 60% 升至 83%；跨用户 4-shot 达 89%；跨位置在更多支持样本下约 75%；跨朝向从 75% 提升至 84%。这些结果表明，结合少样本学习的原型网络是当前 CSI 跨域手势识别的最强基线之一
仿真表明，MUSIC 在均匀线阵下比 Root-MUSIC 和 ESPRIT 精度更高，但波束宽度更宽，且对相干源不高效
在反射定位（声学/无线）场景中，带有频率平滑的 EB-MVDR 可以达到与 EB-MUSIC 相当的精度，且无需预先已知源数量，因此更适应真实多径环境
在 THz 频段，超宽带宽导致波束分裂（beam split）：不同子载波上波束指向不同方向；在近场中该现象还具有距离依赖性，使远场校正技术失效
模型驱动方法中，近场波束分裂感知的 OMP（NB-aware OMP）通过利用角度和距离偏差构造字典，可有效缓解波束分裂影响
另一重要进展是稀疏贝叶斯学习（SBL）：将波束分裂建模为阵列扰动，联合估计 THz 信道与波束分裂，数值仿真显示优于现有方法，且比时间延迟器网络硬件成本更低
6G ISAC 不应把每个基站变成独立雷达，而应在现有通信架构上叠加感知能力，重点用于环境背景感知、车辆/固定 UE 感知等规模化场景
尤其 UE 侧上报感知数据时，若包含敏感位置或环境信息，可能造成隐私泄露
毫米波/sub-THz 感知甚至可提取呼吸频率和心率等生理数据，因此隐私设计必须成为算法策略的一部分
